<include name="Layout_PVROSDChannel">
        <param name="detailed">false</param>
        <param name="selected">false</param>
        <param name="channelwidth">380</param>
        <definition>
            <control type="group">
                <width>$PARAM[channelwidth]</width>
                <include content="Layout_PVRGuide_Channels">
                    <param name="detailed">$PARAM[detailed]</param>
                    <param name="selected">$PARAM[selected]</param>
                </include>
                <control type="image">
                    <right>50</right>
                    <centertop>50%</centertop>
                    <aspectratio align="right">keep</aspectratio>
                    <height>32</height>
                    <texture>$VAR[Image_PVRGuide_Indicator]</texture>
                </control>
            </control>
            <control type="group">
                <left>$PARAM[channelwidth]</left>
                <control type="group">
                    <left>20</left>
                    <right>20</right>
                    <include content="Object_Control" condition="$PARAM[selected]">
                        <param name="control">image</param>
                        <include content="Texture_Menu_Highlight_H">
                            <param name="border">40,0,40,0</param>
                        </include>
                        <include content="Dimension_Padding"><param name="pad">1</param></include>
                    </include>
                    <control type="group">
                        <width>100%</width>
                        <include content="Object_Control">
                            <param name="control">progress</param>

                            <include content="Dimension_Padding" condition="$PARAM[selected]">
                                <param name="pad">1</param>
                            </include>
                            <include content="Dimension_Padding"><param name="pad">3</param></include>

                            <texturebg colordiffuse="00ffffff">pvr/progressline-back3.png</texturebg>
                            <lefttexture border="40,0,0,0" colordiffuse="$VAR[ColorPVRProgress]">pvr/progressline-left3.png</lefttexture>
                            <midtexture border="0" colordiffuse="$VAR[ColorPVRProgress]">pvr/progressline-mid3.png</midtexture>
                            <righttexture border="0,0,40,0" colordiffuse="$VAR[ColorPVRProgress]">pvr/progressline-right3.png</righttexture>
                            <info>ListItem.Progress</info>
                            <visible>Integer.IsGreater(ListItem.Progress,1)</visible>
                        </include>
                        <include content="Layout_PVRChannel_Programs">
                            <param name="detailed">$PARAM[detailed]</param>
                            <param name="selected">$PARAM[selected]</param>
                        </include>
                    </control>
                </control>
            </control>
        </definition>
    </include>

    <include name="Layout_PVRChannel_Programs">
